agent.title: AI Assistant
agent.noModelsHint: No models available. Configure and verify a provider in settings first.
agent.chatPlaceholder: Ask the assistant… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline)
agent.systemPrompt: You are the assistant embedded in Prompt TikZ, a local-first TikZ workbench. The user writes TikZ/LaTeX source in the editor on the left and sees the rendered drawing on the right. Answer in {{language}}. You can read the current source and render status, and — with the user's confirmation — replace the editor's source. Help the user draw figures, debug LaTeX errors, and improve their TikZ code.
agent.localBaseUrlHint: Base URL of any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. Ollama); models are discovered automatically.
